body:
Equivalent fractions.

1/2, 2/4 and 4/8 name the same amount.

Multiply the numerator and the denominator by the same number:
1/2 = (1 × 2)/(2 × 2) = 2/4

Why does it work? When you split every piece into 2 smaller pieces, you have twice as many pieces, and each one is half as big. The amount you shaded does not change.

Use fraction strips to check: they line up!

Later in the unit we compare fractions. Is 3/8 more or less than 1/2? Is 2/3 more than 3/4? Equivalent fractions help us find out.
title: Same Amount, Different Names
